verdict.rationale: Mastra Code stores data in a local SQLite database by default, and its docs let users point it at a remote database instead. That gives the user control over where thread and session data lives, but it is a storage-backend choice rather than a documented region or residency selection. missing for 10: explicit region/residency controls or documentation, coverage of where data sent to model providers is processed or stored, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
